'''Human for IT''', sometimes called '''Social IT''', is the practice of making digital technology accessible and usable by as many people as possible.

It addresses the social dimension of [[Sustainable IT|sustainable IT]] from the standpoint of digital technology itself: who benefits from it, who is excluded, and under what conditions it is produced.

== Areas ==

* '''[[Digital accessibility]]''' for people with disabilities ;
* '''inclusion''' and the fight against digital exclusion ;
* '''production conditions''': mining, assembly, and annotation of training data ;
* '''quality of working life''' for those who use these tools daily ;
* '''interface ethics''', against deceptive design.
